method: a genuine Avito item page rendered in the operator's Chrome over CDP (page.content()); trimmed to the <title> and the single application/ld+json script, both byte-for-byte as Avito served them. The rest of the 729 KB page (scripts, seller widgets, personal data surfaces) was dropped. The listing is a shop's, the description carries no phone or e-mail.

ground_truth.note: schema.org @graph: Product name «iPhone 15, 128 ГБ, SIM + eSIM», sku 7924452716, offers.price "39990" RUB, availability InStock, itemCondition NewCondition, 2 images; plus a BreadcrumbList. On 2026-10-12 /web/1/js/items?itemId=7924452716 answered the generic catalog envelope (no item object), which is why the card reads this page.
